messages:
Maria (CS): quick kickoff for Harbinger onboarding — want to align stakeholders, success criteria, and timeline. Can we do a quick async sync here? :wave:
Priya (CSM): I'll loop in the Harbinger contacts. PM is Tara, infra lead is Omar.
Tara (Harbinger-PM): hi all — thanks. We’re aiming for a pilot in ~6 weeks. Main goals: inference at scale + safe routing.
Jin (SRE): thanks — need expected QPS and any latency SLOs. Also whether they require private deployment (VPC) or hosted.
Omar (Harbinger-Infra): we'll need KMS + VPC peering if private. That could add ~2 weeks.
Liam (Onboarding Eng): from our side, target perf baseline: p50 <200ms, error rate <2% under pilot load. Can Harbinger provide test corpus?
Tara (Harbinger-PM): can provide a 10k-example test set by 2024-03-15. KMS ownership: our infra team owns the keys.
Maria (CS): proposed success criteria (draft): 1) demo parity for top-3 flows; 2) p50 <200ms during 1k rps soak; 3) <2% error rate; 4) runbook & team trained. Thoughts?
Priya (CSM): looks good. Add adoption metric: 30% of pilot users must complete primary flow without fallback.
Jin (SRE): recommend canary plan: 10% traffic 48h, monitor latency & errors, then 50% for 24h before full. Rollback if error spike >1.5% or p50 breach >250ms.
Liam (Onboarding Eng): draft rollout timeline:
```
Week 0: infra setup (VPC/KMS), access + IAM
Week 1: model validation + perf tests
Week 2: pilot (10% traffic), runbook dry-run
Week 3: expand -> 50% -> full if stable
```
Maria (CS): noting renewal risk: KMS delays and long-prompt latency unknowns. Flagging as medium-high. If key setup slips, renewal conversation could be impacted.
Omar (Harbinger-Infra): KMS approval process needs SOC-2 attestation copy from Redwood. Who owns providing that? @Priya
Priya (CSM): I'll attach SOC-2 to the ticket and introduce Security lead.
security-team-bot: Created ticket SEC-456 for KMS & compliance: https://redwood.internal/tickets/SEC-456 :lock:
Maria (CS): action items (owner / due): 1) Omar share KMS contact & constraints / 2024-03-12 (Omar), 2) Harbinger provide test set / 2024-03-15 (Tara), 3) SE training session + runbook / 2024-03-18 (Liam), 4) perf test slot / 2024-03-16 (Jin).
Jin (SRE): I'll reserve perf slot 2024-03-16 10:00-12:00 PT and invite Liam & Tara.
Liam (Onboarding Eng): booking invite now and will attach initial runbook draft.
Tara (Harbinger-PM): thanks — I'll confirm internal availability and share SLA expectations.
Maria (CS): I'll post a kickoff doc to the Harbinger private channel and follow up with calendar invites. Please add any blockers here. :thumbsup:
Priya (CSM): I’ll prepare a short enablement deck for the Harbinger support team; can someone review before 3/17?
Liam (Onboarding Eng): I can review 3/16 after perf tests.
Omar (Harbinger-Infra): noting potential blocker: internal procurement for HSM if required. Will update by 3/12.
Maria (CS): great — closing the async thread for now. Will open a weekly cadence invite if no major blockers. Ping me for urgent issues.
Tara (Harbinger-PM): appreciated — talk soon.
